discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators
subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological quantum materials
motivation: Topological insulators established that band structures of ordinary crystalline solids carry robust topological invariants, creating a new classification of electronic phases of matter. Kane (with Mele) introduced the Z2 invariant and the quantum spin Hall effect in time-reversal-invariant systems, and with Fu extended it to three dimensions. Molenkamp's group observed quantized edge conduction in HgTe quantum wells (2007), the first realization of a two-dimensional topological insulator. Hasan's group used angle- and spin-resolved photoemission to directly image the helical Dirac surface states of Bi-based compounds (2008-2009), demonstrating spin-momentum locking and the odd number of surface Dirac cones that defines three-dimensional topological order. Theory, transport and spectroscopy converged into a result that has held across many materials and probes. It reshaped quantum materials research, leading to Weyl semimetals, topological superconductivity, and the quantum anomalous Hall effect, and it made spectroscopy of band topology a lasting experimental discipline.
